# Configuration profiles

Jamf Classic macOS configuration profiles — lifecycle (list, get, create, clone, copy, delete, redeploy). For **payload / MCX / ACS** editing, use the dedicated [profile payloads](/docs/docs/profile-payloads) cookbook.

## Surfaces

| Do this | BuddyScript | CLI | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----|-------|
| List / load | `profiles(...)` / `profile(id=…)` / `profile_xml(id=…)` | `buddy profile list` / `get xml` | XML string is the same Classic document |
| Clone | `profile_clone(id, name)` | `buddy profile clone` | Same tenant; new UUIDs; unassigned scope |
| Copy / migrate | `profile_copy(..., to_tenant?, to_auth?)` | — | Source = tenant/auth; dest = to_* |
| Create | `profile_xml_prepare_for_create` → `profile_create_xml` | `buddy profile create` | XML on stdin / `--file`; or greenfield `profile_create` + payloads |
| Delete | `profile_delete(id)` | `buddy profile delete` |  |
| Write back | `profile_put_xml(id, xml_str)` | `buddy profile set xml` | After offline edits |
| Redeploy / ACS | `profile_redeploy` / `profile_acs_bind_uuid` | `buddy profile redeploy` | ACS bind is BuddyScript-only when HTML scrape fails |

## Notes

Payload / MCX / ACS editing is covered in [profile payloads](/docs/docs/profile-payloads).

## Example

```python
def main():
    xml = profile_xml(id=42)
    plist = profile_xml_extract_payloads(xml)
    rows = payloads_list_identifiers(plist)
    # Custom payloads: identifier is often reverse-DNS. Jamf Apple payloads: identifier is often a UUID; type is reverse-DNS.
    ident = rows[0]["identifier"]
    xml = profile_xml_patch_payload(xml, identifier=ident, new_payload={"Key": "New"})
    profile_put_xml(id=42, xml_str=xml)
    return "ok"
```
